package myce

import (
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"
 "time"
)

func TestWriteReviewPartialArtifacts(t *testing.T) {
 root := os.Getenv("WP8_REVIEW_PARTIALS")
 if root == "" { t.Fatal("isolated output required") }
 if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 source := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "queue.db")
 q, err := Open(source, "/fixture/checkpoints", &fakeClock{now: time.Unix(1000, 0)})
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 defer q.Close()
 submit(t, q, spec("experiment"))
 for _, suffix := range []string{"", "-wal", "-shm", ".lock"} {
  b, err := os.ReadFile(source+suffix); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "queue.db"+suffix), b, 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 }
 if _, err = SetHostMemoryBudget(filepath.Join(root, "host"), 3); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
}
